body:
Operator request (human decision 2026-10-03): production code must carry Javadoc, enforced by the build.

Policy (committed): docs/guidance/java-spring.md section 8 — every public type and public/protected method in src/main/java documents its contract (purpose, @param, @return, @throws, invariants); records document components with @param; every feature package has a package-info.java; test methods carry no Javadoc; the Gradle javadoc task runs with -Xdoclint:all -Werror and check depends on it (snippet in the guide); code review judges that the text says something the signature does not (docs/guidance/review.md section 4, code_review row).

Routing proposal for the lead (you decide): apply inside slice 01-create-redirect, which already owns build.gradle.kts and src/main/java/dev/urlshort/web/.
1. Design agent (design in progress): add a Documentation line to design.md (Javadoc contract per guide section 8; package-info.java for link/, audit/, web/).
2. Builder: wire the javadoc task into check in the same gated first commit as the dependency overrides, then document everything the gate flags. Existing classes from 00-hello that the gate will flag: src/main/java/dev/urlshort/UrlshortApplication.java (no Javadoc), src/main/java/dev/urlshort/ping/PingController.java and PingResponse.java (class-level only), src/main/java/dev/urlshort/web/RequestIdFilter.java (class-level only). ping/ and UrlshortApplication.java are outside 01's territory: please grant them for Javadoc-only edits (no behaviour change), or route a tiny docs commit on main yourself.
3. QA: scripts/gw check now includes javadoc; coverage unchanged. Code review: ledger line per new public type.
Please record your routing decision in missions/01-greenfield-core/NOTES.md. No reply needed to the operator.
summary: Javadoc policy adopted (guide java-spring.md §8): wire javadoc -Xdoclint:all -Werror into check and document public API — route into slice 01
